description: On the 1st of each month: creates one shared review form, then one WorkQ review item per employee per client, assigned to each client's primary contact in their portal.

nodes.code:
from datetime import date

month_label = date.today().strftime('%B %Y')

# One shared review form per month — every client's review items attach this
# same form, so all responses collect in one place.
created = api.forms.create_from_template(
    form_template_id=params['form_template_id'],
    values={'review_month': {'type': 'text', 'value': month_label}},
    name='Performance Review — ' + month_label,
)
form_id = created['form_id']
